nodes.name: event-checkout.ts
nodes.summary: Handles Stripe checkout session configuration for events. Provides utilities to resolve checkout mode (embedded vs hosted), calculate checkout amounts with promo codes, and build Stripe session parameters with proper branding and metadata.

nodes.name: masterminds-checkout-branding.ts
nodes.summary: Configuration constants for Masterminds HQ checkout branding. Mirrors canonical branding from mhq-homepage to ensure consistent Stripe checkout appearance across workshop-site.

nodes.name: stripe-amount.ts
nodes.summary: Utility functions for Stripe USD amount conversion. Converts dollar amounts to Stripe unit amounts (cents) and enforces minimum charge requirements.

nodes.name: waitlist-notify-windows.ts
nodes.summary: Determines notification timing windows for event reminders. Calculates hours until event start and resolves whether a notification should be sent at 5-hour or 2-hour windows.

nodes.name: checkout-branding.test.ts
nodes.summary: Test suite validating checkout branding consistency. Ensures Stripe checkout sessions carry correct Masterminds branding and logo values match the canonical mhq-homepage values.

nodes.name: event-checkout.test.ts
nodes.summary: Test suite for event checkout functionality. Tests checkout mode resolution, amount calculation with promo codes, and session parameter generation for both embedded and hosted checkout flows.

nodes.name: hardening.test.ts
nodes.summary: Security and edge-case hardening tests. Covers email/session ID regex validation, donation amount bounds, promo code length guards, notification timing windows, and promo code resolution edge cases.

nodes.name: resolveCheckoutMode
nodes.summary: Resolves the checkout mode (embedded or hosted) based on requested mode and capability. Defaults to hosted mode unless explicitly embedded and supported.

nodes.name: resolveEventCheckoutAmount
nodes.summary: Calculates checkout amount based on event pricing, promo code, and optional donation. Handles both donation mode and fixed-price modes with percentage or fixed-amount discounts.

nodes.name: buildEventCheckoutSessionParams
nodes.summary: Builds Stripe checkout session parameters with proper branding, URLs, and metadata. Handles both embedded and hosted checkout flows with seat reservation support.

nodes.name: toStripeUnitAmount
nodes.summary: Converts dollar amount to Stripe unit amount (cents). Returns null if amount is below Stripe's minimum charge threshold ($0.50).

nodes.name: hoursUntilEvent
nodes.summary: Calculates hours remaining until event start time. Returns positive for future events, negative for past events.

nodes.name: resolveNotifyWindow
nodes.summary: Determines if current time falls within a notification window (5-hour or 2-hour before event). Returns null if outside both windows.

nodes.name: EventCheckoutMode
nodes.summary: Type alias for checkout mode. Represents either 'embedded' or 'hosted' Stripe checkout flow.

nodes.name: NotifyWindow
nodes.summary: Union type representing notification window information. Either an object with windowLabel and variant or null if outside notification windows.

nodes.name: email-suppressions.ts

nodes.name: isSuppressed

nodes.name: recordSuppression

nodes.name: SuppressionSource

nodes.name: Giveaway and Entry-Point Backlog
nodes.summary: Ranked and rated list of giveaway entry-point ideas for Masterminds HQ. Contains 11 ideas rated by feasibility (automatable 1-5), effort level, and current status (LIVE, NEXT, IDEA, PARKED).
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown table format with hyperlinks to related documentation and live URLs

nodes.name: Giveaway Launch Workflow
nodes.summary: Complete end-to-end process for delivering free lead magnets, skills, and resources to attract and qualify leads. Three phases: Technical Setup, Content Creation, and Publishing.

nodes.name: Phase 1: Technical Setup
nodes.summary: Technical foundation for launching a giveaway including page creation, registry registration, deployment to production, and verification.

nodes.name: Phase 2: Content Creation
nodes.summary: Content and hook generation using HookLab for creating engaging Instagram reels. Includes hook writing (Pass 1: CTA First) and full script generation (Pass 2).

nodes.name: Phase 3: Publishing
nodes.summary: Publishing and activation of giveaway content on Instagram and ManyChat automation verification.

nodes.name: Giveaway Template Structure
nodes.summary: Hardened template requirements for giveaway pages including 14 required elements: client directive, animations, particles, gradients, fonts, badges, buttons, testimonials, CTA blocks, reactions, attribution, theme, and scroll effects.

nodes.name: Giveaway Email Collection Pattern
nodes.summary: Email capture mechanism for converting giveaway visitors into leads. Includes modal component (GiveawayEmailModal / GiveawayAutoModal), submission contract to /api/lead-magnet, regex validation, and rate limiting.

nodes.name: ManyChat Automation Setup
nodes.summary: Instagram comment automation for giveaway delivery. Comment trigger on keyword, DM ask for email, email capture, and delivery message with link. Manual flow creation via ManyChat UI using MASTER template clone.

nodes.name: The Cost Stack Audit Giveaway
nodes.summary: Live giveaway (LIVE since 2026-08-03, slug: cost-stack). A calculator-type entry point that helps identify cost leakage. Keyword: STACK. Automatable: 5/5. Effort: 1 review pass. Discovered email delivery production bug during launch.

nodes.name: Bring the Task You Hate Giveaway
nodes.summary: Free live workshop/hot-seat (LIVE Sept 29 2026, slug: bring-the-task-you-hate). Originally proposed 2026-09-16, runs as 'Free AI Class: Bring the Task You Hate the Most. Leave Without It.' 56 signups on July 29 run, 7 net-new C4 qualified. Zero prep required—intake answers serve as run sheet.

nodes.name: Make AI Sound Like You Giveaway
nodes.summary: Free live workshop/build-along (NEXT status, slug: stop-sounding-like-everyone-else). Focuses on voice profile + Speak Human. 90 min live delivery. Aug 4 run got 10 signups on two days promo. Needs 10-14 days runway plus Marina ref link.

nodes.name: Clone guardog Rule
nodes.summary: Template selection rule: clone guardog (not benchmark, not compare) regardless of content type. Structure determines template, not content. Benchmark and compare pre-date hardened template and are non-conforming.

nodes.name: Email Modal Trigger Pattern
nodes.summary: Universal requirement for giveaway pages. Copy-prompt pages open modal on Copy button. Non-copy-prompt pages auto-open after 20-second delay, suppressed by sessionStorage for once-per-session delivery.

nodes.name: GiveawayAutoModal Component
nodes.summary: Reusable component (src/components/giveaways/GiveawayAutoModal.tsx) that encapsulates auto-popup state, timer, sessionStorage, and email collection for non-copy-prompt giveaway pages. Replaces verbose inline pattern.

nodes.name: Three Delivery Edits Rule
nodes.summary: Creating a giveaway requires three file edits: page file, registry entry (giveaways.ts), and delivery template entry plus slug in lead-magnets.ts. Missing any one silently breaks the email delivery path.

nodes.name: Resend Email Delivery Bug (2026-08-03)
nodes.summary: Production incident: all giveaway delivery emails failed with Resend 422 error. Root cause: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL had trailing newline, which broke the List-Unsubscribe header. Fixed by trimming/stripping CR/LF in getSiteUrl(). Guard tests added to prevent recurrence.

nodes.name: Giveaway Mobile Design Rules
nodes.summary: Mobile-specific requirements for giveaway pages including badge positioning (relative z-10 on mobile, absolute sm:top-10), aurora blob sizes (320px mobile, 500px sm, 600px md), code block text wrapping, and section padding (px-5 py-8 sm:px-8 sm:py-10).

nodes.name: HookLab Integration
nodes.summary: Two-pass hook and reel script generation. Pass 1 (CTA First mode) generates 15 hook candidates scored on 5 axes (Concreteness, Mechanism, Voice, Self-recognition, Thumb stop). Pass 2 generates full 45s reel script with on-screen callouts, delivery notes, and Instagram caption.

nodes.name: Giveaway Pre-flight Checklist
nodes.summary: Four uniqueness checks before launching: slug directory, registry entry, ManyChat keyword, and git repo cleanliness. All must pass before touching any files.

nodes.name: Giveaway Delivery Domain Configuration
nodes.summary: Canonical delivery domain is https://workshop.mastermindshq.business/giveaways/<slug>. Legacy domain https://workshop-site-sigma.vercel.app/ still works but should be phased out. Domain consistency is outstanding across all giveaway rows.

layers.name: Presentation Layer
layers.description: React components, Next.js pages, and layouts that render the user interface. Includes event pages, giveaway forms, session guides, resource vaults, and interactive UI components.

layers.name: API Gateway & Backend Routes
layers.description: Next.js API routes that serve as the entry point for backend operations. Handles HTTP requests, coordinates between presentation and domain layers, and manages request validation and error handling.

layers.name: Domain & Business Logic Layer
layers.description: Core business logic and domain models. Implements event management, registration workflows, capacity management, pricing, status tracking, and event-specific operations. Contains the primary business rules independent of infrastructure.

layers.name: External Integration Layer
layers.description: Adapters and integration points for external services including payment processing (Stripe), email delivery (Resend), calendar services (Google Calendar), and database operations (Supabase). Handles all third-party API communication.

layers.name: Utilities & Cross-Cutting Concerns
layers.description: Shared utility functions for validation, formatting, rate limiting, caching, and common operations. Provides infrastructure-level support functions used across multiple layers.

layers.name: Content & Static Data Layer
layers.description: Structured content definitions, guides, educational materials, and static data. Includes session prep content, workshop guides, giveaway data, and speaker/mentor information.

tour.title: Project Overview & Homepage
tour.description: Start with the homepage to understand the site structure and main features. The homepage displays session guides as the core offering of the workshop portal. It imports the sessions registry and renders them using reusable components like SessionCard and Reveal animations.

tour.title: Event System Architecture
tour.description: Events are the core business entity. This layer defines all event metadata, types, and structures. The events library exports type definitions for EventDefinition, EventHost, EventPromoCode, EventSection and content configuration. Understanding this layer is essential before working with event pages, registrations, or payments.

tour.title: Registration & Payment Flow
tour.description: The registration system handles attendee sign-ups, payment processing via Stripe, and seat capacity management. The checkout route (POST /api/events/checkout-session) orchestrates validation, Stripe session creation, registration saving, and confirmation emails. The event-registration-db module manages Supabase database operations for storing registrations and intake profiles.

tour.title: Email Automation & Confirmations
tour.description: Emails drive the attendee lifecycle: registration confirmations, session reminders, abandoned checkout follow-ups, and location reminders. The event-confirmation-email module sends confirmation emails with personalized details. Session reminders and location reminders are triggered by scheduled API routes. The email-email-ledger tracks outbound email history.

tour.title: Giveaways & Lead Magnets
tour.description: Giveaways are free lead-generation pages that capture email addresses and optional profile data. Each giveaway is registered in the giveaways registry and gets its own page route under /giveaways/<slug>/. Lead magnets deliver downloadable resources on sign-up. The system includes email gates (GiveawayEmailModal) and form validation to build mailing lists.

tour.title: React Components & UI Layer
tour.description: The UI is built with reusable React components organized by domain. SiteChrome, SiteHeader, and SiteFooter provide layout structure. EventPageView and EventRegistrationSection render event details and forms. Reveal and StaggerList add entrance animations. Interactive components like WaitlistJoinForm and GiveawayAutoModal handle user input. Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion power styling and animation.

tour.title: AI Agent Income Prompt-Pack Flow
tour.description: Trace the prompt-pack request from the public page and email gate through its API route, webhook, and supporting library.

tour.title: Giveaway Evaluation Materials
tour.description: Review the updated usefulness rubric, process notes, lessons, and grading examples that support giveaway evaluation.
